common.noChanges: Nothing changed — no new version was created.
common.noCommands: No command is available to you in this state.
common.decisionNoneAvailable: No decision of the required type exists yet. Governance decisions are raised in the Committee Hub.

decisionIssue.wrong_type: The linked decision is not of the required type.
decisionIssue.recommended: The linked decision is recommended — pending the external authority; it is not a final approval.
decisionIssue.not_approved: Linked decision status: {status} — only an approved decision counts.
decisionIssue.external_approval_missing: The decision is outside the committee delegation and no approval by the authorized body is recorded.
decisionIssue.authority_unassessed: The decision has no authority assessment (within mandate / external authority).

common.noControl: This centre documents readiness and transition work. It never controls devices, networks or power: changes happen in the approved operational systems and are recorded here with evidence.

overview.title: Day-1 & TSA Center
overview.subtitle: Site and service readiness, transition plans with the go/no-go decision, TSAs and their exits.
overview.coverageAll: Every Day-1 readiness area has at least one check.

checks.title: Readiness checks
checks.subtitle: Site and workstream Day-1 checklists: mandatory blockers, test history and specialist sign-off.

create.title: New readiness check
create.effect: Creates a check that starts non-waivable; waivability is a later specialist determination.
create.signoffHint: Only holders of this role (with the sign-off permission) can sign the check off.

instantiate.title: Add the template's Day-1 checklist
instantiate.effect: Creates the project template's default checks (all Day-1 areas) for the selected site. Existing template checks are kept — nothing is duplicated.

check.notDetermined: Not yet determined by a specialist

tests.title: Test history
tests.hint: Append-only: a failed test stays visible after a later pass. A passing test never signs the check off.

record.title: Record a test run
record.effect: Appends a test run to the history (never edited).
record.effectFail: A failed test sets the check to failed; a failed blocker blocks GO.

signoff.title: Specialist sign-off
signoff.effect: Only the assigned specialist role signs off, on active evidence, when the latest test did not fail.
signoff.sod: Separation of duties: the owner and whoever recorded the latest test or evidence cannot sign off.

determine.title: Criticality and waivability (specialist)
determine.effect: Records the criticality, waivability and waiver authority with a documented basis. Pending waiver approvals become stale.

reopen.title: Reopen the check
reopen.effect: Returns a passed / not-applicable / waived check to in progress; its history is kept.

edit.title: Edit check
edit.effect: Changes descriptive fields only — never the status, criticality, waivability or sign-off.

waivers.title: Waivers of this check
waivers.requestEffect: Creates a waiver request bound to this version of the check, for approval by the waiver authority.
waivers.nonWaivable: This check is not waivable: an exception can never override it. A request is refused and logged.
waivers.authority: Approval needs the {role} role (not the requester).

waivers.title: Readiness waivers
waivers.subtitle: Waivers of readiness checks: basis, impact, the specialist-set authority and the approval.

approve.title: Approve waiver of {code}
approve.effect: Marks the check waived with this waiver; a waived blocker no longer blocks GO while the waiver is effective.
approve.authorityHint: Only the holder of the waiver authority role — never the requester — can approve.

reject.title: Reject waiver of {code}
reject.effect: The waiver is rejected; the check stays unmet.

cutover.title: Cutover & go/no-go
cutover.subtitle: Transition plans: runbook, window, service impact, accountable owner, communications, testing, contingency/rollback and the go/no-go decision.

create.title: New cutover plan
create.effect: Creates a plan in planning. It can go to go/no-go only when every §7.4 element is documented.

fields.title: Title
fields.siteLocked: The site decides which readiness checks gate this transition — change it with "Change site" (reason required).

prereq.title: Transition prerequisites (§7.4)
prereq.hint: Fail-closed: every element is required before a GO; anything not documented counts as missing.

go.title: GO evaluation (server)
go.allowed: GO is allowed: no open blocker and every prerequisite is documented.
go.blocked: GO is blocked. The server refuses a GO until the items below are cleared.
go.flagged: The GO is flagged: a gating readiness check is open again after the GO. Recording the execution is refused until it is cleared or waived — or return the plan to planning for a new GO on a new decision.
go.evidenceInvalid: Signed off, but its sign-off evidence is no longer active (rejected, superseded or contested) — a fresh sign-off is required.

checks.title: Readiness checks gating this plan
checks.hint: A project-wide plan is gated by every check not bound to another plan; a site plan by its site's checks and the checks bound to it.
checks.empty: No readiness check gates this plan.

decision.title: Go/no-go decision (governance)
decision.hidden: A decision is linked but you cannot view it.
decision.ok: Final approval — can back a GO.
decision.linkEffect: Links a governance decision of type Day-1 go/no-go. Only a final approval can back a GO; the link itself approves nothing.

history.title: Decision history
history.hint: Every submission, decision and refused GO — with the blockers at that moment. Never edited.

kinds.go_flagged: GO flagged — a gating check is open again
kinds.execution_blocked: Execution record refused by the server
kinds.check_bound: Readiness check now gates this transition
kinds.check_unbound: Readiness check no longer gates this transition

rehearsal.title: Record rehearsal / testing
rehearsal.effect: Records the testing summary and marks the transition rehearsed.

comms.title: Record communications approval
comms.effect: Records the reference of the approval of the transition communications.

submit.title: Submit for go/no-go
submit.effect: Only possible with every §7.4 element documented. You will not be able to decide it yourself.

back.title: Return to planning
back.effect: The plan can be changed again; earlier decisions stay in the history.
back.goEffect: The GO is withdrawn: the go/no-go decision it consumed cannot back a new GO — a new decision is needed.

decide.title: Record the go/no-go decision
decide.effect: A GO is re-evaluated by the server now: an open blocker or a missing prerequisite refuses it, and the refusal is recorded in the history.
decide.sod: The person who submitted the plan cannot decide it.

execute.title: Record the execution
execute.effect: Records that the transition was executed in the approved operational systems (reference it in the note). Nothing is executed from here.

rollback.title: Record the rollback
rollback.effect: Records that the contingency / rollback was invoked.

accept.title: Post-transition acceptance
accept.effect: Only the accountable owner, not the person who recorded the execution, accepts — on active acceptance evidence.

edit.title: Edit cutover plan
edit.effect: Only while planning or rehearsing; never changes the status or the decision.
edit.locked: The plan is locked in this state — return it to planning to change it.

site.title: Change the site of this transition
site.effect: The readiness checks of the new site gate this transition; those of the current site no longer do. The decision history records the change with your reason.
site.failedRule: Refused while a failed blocking or mandatory check of the current site would stop gating the transition.

tsa.title: TSA register
tsa.subtitle: Transitional services: owner, end date, replacement and exit. Reaching the end date is never an exit.

expiry.exit_acceptance_pending: Ended {days} day(s) ago — exit approval pending

create.title: Register a TSA service
create.effect: Creates the service as proposed. Approval needs a complete record and a final governance decision.

fields.name: Service
fields.enduringLocked: Whether the service is an enduring arrangement is part of the approved terms: it can no longer be changed.

tsaDetail.endNotExit: Reaching the end date is not an exit: an unreplaced service becomes expired-unresolved and is escalated. Extensions need an approved decision; the exit needs accepted replacement evidence and an independent approver.
tsaDetail.milestonesEmpty: No exit milestone yet (required for approval).

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.hidden: An escalation exists; open the Committee Hub to view it.

extend.title: Extend the TSA
extend.impact: Requires an approved decision recorded against the TSA (request extension, then record extension); cost and obligations continue

interim.title: Alternative interim / continuity arrangement
interim.impact: The continuity plan is executed; the TSA stays unresolved until an exit is accepted with evidence

replan.title: Accelerate / re-plan the replacement service
replan.impact: Exit only after the replacement is accepted with evidence and the exit is approved

extension.title: Extension
extension.ok: Final approval — can back the extension.

transition.title: TSA state command
transition.effect: Applies an allowed state-machine command. Exit, extension and expiry have their own guarded commands.

approve.title: Approve TSA terms
approve.effect: Needs a complete record (owner, scope, dates, exit milestones, replacement) and a FINAL governance decision of type TSA approval/extension.

acceptReplacement.title: Accept the replacement service
acceptReplacement.effect: Needs active, non-conflicting acceptance evidence linked to this TSA (evidence panel below).

failure.title: Report a replacement failure
failure.effect: Withdraws any replacement acceptance and raises an escalation (decision requested) with continuity and extension options. Nothing is extended.
failure.done: Failure reported; an escalation was raised.

requestExtension.title: Request an extension
requestExtension.effect: Links an extension decision paper that the committee has not decided yet (draft, submitted or under review) with the proposed end date and continuity plan, so the committee decides on these terms. Nothing is extended until the decision is finally approved.
requestExtension.done: Extension requested — awaiting the approved decision.

recordExtension.title: Record the approved extension
recordExtension.effect: Applies the proposed end date ONLY if the linked decision is a final approval; otherwise the server refuses it.

requestExit.title: Request exit approval
requestExit.effect: Binds the request to this version of the TSA and to the accepted replacement evidence; a later change invalidates it.

approveExit.title: Approve the TSA exit
approveExit.effect: Accepts the exit on the accepted replacement evidence.
approveExit.sod: The TSA owner, the requester and the replacement acceptor cannot approve.

rejectExit.title: Reject the exit approval
rejectExit.effect: The request is rejected; the TSA stays in its current state.

edit.title: Edit TSA
edit.effect: Descriptive fields only. Dates of an approved TSA change only through an approved extension; the status never changes here.

codes.tsa_approve_decision_already_used: This decision already approved the terms of another TSA: one decision approves the terms of one TSA. This TSA needs its own decision.
codes.tsa_approve_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external approval behind this decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot approve TSA terms.
codes.tsa_approve_decision_other_subject: This decision was raised for another record: it cannot approve the terms of this TSA.
codes.tsa_extension_decision_already_used: This decision already authorized an extension (of this TSA or another): a further extension needs a new decision.
codes.tsa_extension_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external approval behind this decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot authorize an extension.
codes.tsa_extension_decision_other_subject: This decision was raised for another record: it cannot authorize an extension of this TSA.
codes.go_decision_already_used: This go/no-go decision already authorized the GO of another plan, or an earlier GO of this plan: a GO needs its own decision.
codes.go_decision_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the external approval behind this go/no-go decision is no longer valid (rejected, superseded or conflicting): it cannot authorize a GO.
codes.go_decision_other_subject: This decision was raised for another record: it cannot authorize the GO of this plan.
codes.rebind_failed: A failed blocking or mandatory check keeps gating the transition it was raised for until it is cleared (passed, waived or not applicable).
codes.rebind_plan_locked: This open check gates a transition that is under go/no-go decision or has a GO: it cannot be taken out of that transition.
codes.rebind_reason_required: State the reason for re-binding the check to another transition.
codes.determination_release_not_allowed: A determination cannot release an open blocking or mandatory check. A waivable check is released only through the waiver register (basis, impact, waiver authority); a non-waivable one cannot be released.
codes.execution_blocked: The GO is flagged: a gating readiness check is open again after the GO. Clear or waive it, or return the plan to planning for a new GO.
codes.extension_terms_bound: The extension requested on this decision is before the committee: a different end date or continuity plan needs a new decision.
codes.extension_terms_after_outcome: This decision already has an outcome and carries no extension. Link the extension request to a decision paper before the committee decides it, so the paper shows the end date and continuity plan it approves.
codes.extension_terms_after_vote: Voting on this decision has already started. Link the extension request to a decision paper before the committee votes on it, so every vote is cast on the end date and continuity plan it approves.
codes.extension_end_date_past: The new end date is not after today: an extension must extend the service (a passed date needs a new request).
codes.tsa_decision_other_tsa: This decision already backs another TSA (its terms or its extension): a decision about one TSA does not back another TSA.
codes.activate_not_started: The service start date has not been reached: the TSA is activated from its start date.
codes.enduring_locked: Whether the service is an enduring arrangement is part of its approved terms and can no longer be changed.
codes.classification_above_clearance: You cannot classify a record above your own clearance.
codes.site_change_failed_check: A failed blocking or mandatory check of the current site gates this transition: it keeps gating it until it is cleared (passed, waived or not applicable).
codes.site_reason_required: Changing the site of a transition requires a reason.
codes.extension_terms_mismatch: The linked decision does not carry this extension (TSA, end date and continuity plan). Request the extension again on the decision that approved these terms, or on a new decision.
codes.signoff_na_release_not_allowed: A failed blocking or mandatory check — or an open one of a transition under go/no-go decision or with a GO — is not released by a "not applicable" sign-off. Clear it with a passing test and sign-off, or, if it is waivable, through the waiver register.

escalation.expired_unresolved: TSA {code} ({name}) reached its end date {endDate} without an accepted replacement service. This is NOT an exit. Decide on continuity: an extension (approved decision required; never automatic) or an alternative arrangement.
escalation.replacement_failure: The replacement for TSA {code} ({name}) failed: {failureSummary}. Decide on continuity: an extension of the TSA (requires an approved decision; never automatic) or an alternative interim arrangement. Continuity plan: {continuityPlan}

routing.within_authority: {committee} — within its delegated authority (decision type {decisionType}, authority matrix v{matrixVersion})
routing.delegating_authority_tbc: Delegating authority — to be confirmed (decision type {decisionType}, authority matrix v{matrixVersion})
routing.no_matrix: Authorized body — to be confirmed (no approved authority matrix covers TSA decisions)

go_flagged.test_failed: {check}: a test of this gating check failed after the GO.
go_flagged.test_failed_note: {check}: a test of this gating check failed after the GO ({note}).
go_flagged.reopened: {check}: the specialist reopened this gating check after the GO ({note}).
go_flagged.evidence_invalidated: {check}: the evidence of this signed-off gating check was rejected, superseded or contested after the GO.
go_flagged.bound_after_go: {check}: an open gating check was bound to this transition after the GO ({note}).
